exposure: duration of operation lasting longer than 30 min
rupture of membrane before cesarean section
outcome: surgical site infection following cesarean section
cohort: 383 women who gave birth via cesarean section
finding: The prevalence of surgical site infection following cesarean section was 7.8%, with rupture of membrane before CS, vertical skin incision, duration of operation >30 minutes, and interrupted skin closure technique being significantly associated with increased risk.
